subject: Linguistics
title: The Maxim of Manner
description: A 60-second lesson on The Maxim of Manner.

hook.text: 'He activated the mechanism of egress'—or you could just say 'he opened the door.'

buildup.text: The maxim of manner says: be clear, brief, orderly, and avoid obscurity and ambiguity.

discovery.text: Manner is about how you say it—choose the simplest expression that conveys your meaning.

twist.text: Deliberately obscure wording signals something: using a long phrase implies the short one wouldn't fit.

climax.text: 'She produced a series of sounds corresponding to a well-known melody' implies she sang badly.

punchline.text: If you could say it simply but didn't, the listener asks why.

quiz.question: What does the maxim of manner require?
